authority: Frozen depth_profile_v1 results, not later postconfirmatory dynamics
point_definition: Arithmetic mean of five per-seed metrics. A is ratio of cohort mean late M to early M, not mean of per-seed ratios. T_A=A_200k/A_5k; R_P=P_200k/P_5k.

uncertainty.source: Saved per-draw statistic arrays from the original frozen depth-profile bootstrap
uncertainty.sampling_unit: Hierarchical seed+base bootstrap: resample five seeds and bases within each existing feature/sign stratum, independently per architecture
uncertainty.strata: Original feature/sign panel strata; base weights shared across seeds, layers and checkpoints within an architecture

limitations: Seed metrics are cached inputs; raw hidden activations and per-base outputs are not included. Intervals reconstruct quantiles of saved draw statistics, not draw statistics from raw examples. No model inference or training is supported.
